item.title: Saying Goodbye to Janus Contributor
item.description: Murray Roberts, who compiled Collectors Corner in the old Janus Magazine, died recently. There may be some of you there who still remember him. He led the way in researching spankings in mainstream media- movies, TV shows, theatre, newspapers, comics, cartoons, books etc. He was a lovely chap and will be sadly missed.

item.title: Antonia du Bois Recreated
item.description: We were delighted to hear from an old friend of Janus -Pat Greenham. Pat has given us the exclusive rights to “A couple that recreated the Antonia du Bois story from Janus 20”. Janus 20 goes down as one of the favourite issues of all time. Please enjoy and thanks again to Pat.
